title: Fit pinned source-owner verification inside the registration deadline before launcher cutover
outcome: Pinned registration and immutable ACK replay use the owner-approved verification path within the existing registration deadline, without redundant source measurements, guessed capabilities or weakened executable provenance.
acceptance: Before a launcher emits sourceOwner, agree the minimal registration verification with the source_id decision owner; preserve exact configured executable, byte pin, supported source schema, request identity, replay and claim/durability guards without inventing capability evidence or silently extending deadlines.

Focused coverage uses a realistic bounded probe duration to discriminate whether registration leaves sufficient time for claim read and durability, preserving explicit deadline refusal and historical rows; report measured behavior rather than treating source-observation timing as reproduced registration failure.
